quote: The CTERM-GAN model has been tested over two tasks: topic conditioning and sentiment conditioning.

In this short paper we have proposed the Controlled TExt generation Relational Memory GAN (CTERM-GAN), a model aiming to generate sentences that are both syntactically correct and semantically coherent.
